===Specifications=== *CPU: [[Intel Atom]] D2700 Dual Core @2.13GHz *RAM Memory: 1GB DDR3 (SoDIMM) (expandable to 3GB) :Removable SoDIMM for RAM Memory ([[ADATA]] AD3S1333B1G9-BM1G) :Compatible with SoDIMM DDR3-1333 PC3-10600 CL9 timing of 9-9-9 :Manually upgradeable e.g. to [[Kingston]] value RAM KVR1333D3S8S9 ([https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xoBHXC_shHk 2G]) *Drive Type: 3.5" SATA HDD, 2.5" SATA HDD, 2.5" SATA SSD *Max Internal Capacity: 16TB (4x 4TB HDD) *External HDD Interface: 2x USB 3.0, 1x USB 2.0, 1x eSATA *LAN: 2x GbE ports (2x [[Intel]] WG82574L)
==Links of Interest== ===Reviews=== *[http://www.smallnetbuilder.com/nas/nas-reviews/31909-synology-ds412-diskstation-reviewed ''Synology DiskStation DS412+'' on '''SmallNetBuilder'''] :CPU: [[Intel Atom]] D2700 Dual Core @2.13GHz :Flash: 128MB DoM ([[Samsung]] K9F1G08U0C) ::''USBest'' UT165-L46 (Controller) :RAM: 1GB DDR3 SoDIMM (expandable to 3GB) :SouthBridge: [[Intel]] [http://ark.intel.com/products/34395/Intel-82801JR-IO-Controller 82801JR] (ICH10R) [SLB8S] :eSATA: ''[[Silicon Image]]'' Sil3531 PCIe (1x)/eSATA ::''[[Silicon Image]]'' Sil3132 PCIe (1x) (rear eSATA) :USB 3.0: 2x ports; [[NEC]] D720200AF (USB 3.0 Controller) :USB 2.0: 1x port; I/O: ''[[ITE]]'' IT8728F :Ethernet: 2x GbE ports (2x [[Intel]] WG82574L) :uC: [[Microchip]] PIC16F883 (8-bit Microcontroller)
